Capture task-linked GPU utilization samples for each compute-bound experiment.

meta_reflection: Coarse reconstructed timing and a GPU snapshot without task linkage limit this retrospective more than execution time. Task-scoped telemetry is the best next step; no measured counterfactual supports a nonzero savings estimate.
